title: Meeting Ahmet Ertegun and joining Atlantic
summary: Ertegun tracked him down at the Pepper Pot after hearing he was at the Caledonia Inn; Longhair needed money for his children.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you remember how you got hooked up, met, got hooked up with Atlantic, Atlantic Records? Yeah.

I got hooked up with them. Yeah. Yeah. Mr. Erdogan. I heard that he was looking for me when I was at the Caledonia Inn. Oh really? So, I left the Caledonia Inn and went back to the pebble pot. I thought I was here. Yeah. And he tracked me down and he finally found me, you know. Well, I needed the money bad because I was, my kids was uh... You were married at this time?
